hook.name: BlackHoleHook
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/BLK pairs that replaces the standard CLMM with a virtual-reserve constant-product AMM. Acts as its own swap counterparty via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Liquidity is single-sided BLK with time-locked positions. Buy fees partially seal ETH as non-redeemable reserve; sell fees scale dynamically with trade size. Owner can migrate all reserves to an arbitrary address, bypassing LP locks.
